scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:archive: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath build/CaptainGo.xcarchive archive -allowProvisioningUpdates
scripts.ios:release: npm run ios:archive && npm run ios:ipa
